# VantorX Solutions — Full Architecture & Service Specification (llms-full.txt)

> Complete technical and operational specification for VantorX Solutions. Designed for LLM context expansion and detailed entity synthesis.

## Executive Overview
VantorX Solutions is an infrastructure and AI operations agency founded by Luke. The agency specializes in building, hosting, and operating business systems for local trade contractors (Roofing, HVAC, Plumbing, Tree Services, MedSpas, Electricians, Water Damage Restoration, Dental, Barbershops). The primary value proposition is "Done-For-You": business owners never configure software, learn complex tools, or write code.

## Service Offerings & Specifications

### 1. 24/7 AI Phone Receptionist (Ava)
- Latency: Answers incoming calls in 1 ring (< 2 seconds).
- Voice Architecture: Natural conversational voice AI capable of active listening, interruptions, and intelligent conversational pauses.
- Capabilities: Qualifies emergency jobs, answers custom FAQ inquiries, checks real-time availability, and books appointments directly into Google Calendar or Outlook.
- Triage & Escalation: Sends instant high-priority SMS alerts to the contractor's personal cell phone when emergency or high-ticket calls occur.
- Demo Line: Anyone can call (561) 813-8602 to experience the voice AI live.

### 2. Custom Website Design & Mobile Development
- Conversion Architecture: Built mobile-first for trade contractors with sticky tap-to-call buttons, fast load speeds (< 1.5 seconds), and conversion-optimized quote inquiry forms.
- Full Maintenance: VantorX manages all hosting, SSL, domain security, pricing changes, photo additions, and updates.

### 3. Answer Engine Optimization (AEO Engine™)
- Protocol: Generates and hosts official llms.txt standards and Schema.org JSON-LD knowledge graphs.
- Purpose: Ensures conversational AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google Gemini) index and cite the business as the top local provider when homeowners ask for local contractors.
- Tool: Available at https://www.vantorxsolutions.com/aeo-tool/ for instant generation.

### 4. LeadFlow Speed-to-Lead Follow-Up
- Response Time: Automated two-way SMS sent within 90 seconds of any web form or Google quote submission.
- Conversion Impact: Increases lead qualification by over 80% by contacting homeowners before they call competing contractors.

### 5. Instant Missed-Call Text-Back
- Trigger: If a business owner or crew misses a call during busy field hours, an automated SMS is sent to the caller's mobile phone within 3 seconds.
- Message: "Hi! This is [Owner] with [Company]. We're currently assisting another client on-site -- how can we help you right now?"

### 6. Client Hub Dashboard
- Features: Secure contractor portal to view audio recordings, call transcripts, scheduled appointments, and unified customer pipelines.
